title: llms-full.txt and one help article point crawlers at pages that bounce

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail:
llms-full.txt links to member-only addresses that redirect a signed-out reader to sign in (/founder, /journal, /rewards, /upgrade, /on-air, /circles), so an answer engine following them lands on the sign-in page. content/help/spaces/network.md links to /networks, which redirects to /for/networks. Event pages link a Circle by its id (/discover/circles/<uuid>, a redirect to the named address), and /discover/spaces carries links to /support and /partners/<slug> that redirect to the home page. Wanted: public links only in the AI files, and links that point at the final address.

llms-full.txt drops the link from member-only addresses and points /circles at /discover/circles (lib/seo/corpus-links.ts); the Networks help article links /for/networks; an event links its Circle by slug and not at all when the Circle is unlisted; partner cards on /discover/spaces carry rel=nofollow. robots.txt walls /support (exact and subtree), the member page the nav links from the public listing.

verify.note: Fails on main: the corpus quotes member-only links, the Networks article links /networks, the event page links its Circle by id, partner cards and /support invite a crawl. Passes once each points at an address a signed-out reader can open.
